text: True or False: The closure-based skeptical argument and the underdetermination-based skeptical argument rest on one and the same principle, namely epistemic closure.
explanation: They are distinct argumentative structures. The closure-based argument runs through the closure principle (if I know I have hands, I know I am not a BIV), whereas the underdetermination-based argument appeals to an underdetermination principle: because the skeptical scenario is evidentially indistinguishable from the ordinary one, my evidence fails to favor the ordinary hypothesis over its skeptical rival, so I do not know.
